description: This file defines the Image class within the OpenCart system, providing methods for image manipulation such as loading, saving, resizing, cropping, rotating, watermarking, and applying filters. It handles different image formats and integrates with PHP's GD library.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: Class for handling image operations such as loading, saving, resizing, cropping, rotating, watermarking, and filtering images using PHP's GD library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Image object by loading image data from a file, checking for GD extension, and setting properties based on image info.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the filename of the image.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the image resource or object.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the image.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the image.

methods.name: getBits
methods.description: Returns the bits information of the image.

methods.name: getMime
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the image.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the image to a specified file with given quality.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the image to specified dimensions, maintaining aspect ratio based on default parameter.

methods.name: watermark
methods.description: Applies a watermark image onto the current image at a specified position.

methods.name: crop
methods.description: Crops the image to specified top-left and bottom-right coordinates.

methods.name: rotate
methods.description: Rotates the image by a specified degree and color.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Applies a filter to the image (private method).

methods.name: text
methods.description: Adds text to the image (private method).

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges another image onto this image (private method).

methods.name: html2rgb
methods.description: Converts a hex color string to an RGB array.
